purpose: Published reference aboveground biomass for CarbonSight sanity checks. Derived carbon and tCO2e use the product default CF = 0.47 and 44/12. They are arithmetic, not independent chemical measurements, unless carbon_reported_by_paper is set.

conversions.carbon_fraction_source: IPCC 2006 Vol. 4 Ch. 4 Table 4.3 default; 2019 Refinement does not revise Table 4.3

screening_threshold_note: pass_if and fail_if are hackathon screening rules derived from the cited dispersion. They are not published confidence intervals and must not be used to clamp model output.

sites.name: INPA ZF-2 terra-firme forest near Manaus, Brazil

map_anchor.do_not_use: The JIRCAS PDF of Suwa et al. 2013 prints 2°36'S, 11°35'W. That longitude is not near Manaus. Do not navigate there.

sites.what_was_measured: Trees with diameter > 10 cm on a 2500 m by 20 m belt transect (125 subplots of 20 m by 20 m). Understory below 10 cm is excluded.

agb_mg_ha.reported_dispersion: ±28.3, labeled SE by the authors, across adjacent subplots that are not independent samples of the region

topographic_endmembers_2016.source_note: JARQ 50(4) 2016 abstract. Author list not re-copied in this file.

ipcc_2019_table_4_7_context.ecozone: tropical rainforest, North and South America, primary
ipcc_2019_table_4_7_context.note: Ecozone prior, not a measurement of ZF-2.

sequestration_tier1.row: tropical rainforest, North and South America, primary
sequestration_tier1.note: SD exceeds the mean, so the Tier-1 rate is not distinguishable from zero. The 2006 >20-year South America value of 3.1 (range 1.5-5.5) is a different row and should not replace this one for primary forest.

sources.citation: Suwa, R., Sakai, T., dos Santos, J., da Silva, R. P., Kajimoto, T., Ishizuka, M., and Higuchi, N. (2013). JARQ 47(1): 109-114.
Topographic biomass remeasurement in terra-firme forest near Manaus (2016). JARQ 50(4).

sites.name: Old-growth coast redwood, Humboldt Redwoods State Park area, California

park_centroid.status: Humboldt Redwoods State Park centroid from the park's Wikipedia entry, not a plot corner

rockefeller_forest_topo.status: USGS Weott quadrangle feature coordinate, not a Sillett plot corner

map_anchor.study_latitude_band: 40-42 N, primary Sequoia sempervirens forests (Sillett et al. 2024)

plot_allometry_sillett_2020.note: Exceptional 1 ha research plots, including dead-wood input in the gross biomass increase of 14.7-40.7 Mg ha-1 yr-1. Not the expected GEDI polygon mean.

landscape_remote_sensing_sillett_2024.note: GEDI underestimates relative to airborne lidar because height is a weak predictor in the tallest stands. Hectares above 3000 Mg ha-1 are about 1% of primary forest in the study and are concentrated on 460 ha of alluvial terrace in Humboldt Redwoods State Park.

derived_using_default_cf_on_gedi_landsca.warning: Sillett et al. 2020 carbon implies CF about 0.51, not 0.47. 885 * 0.51 * 44/12 = 1655 t CO2e ha-1. Show both.

ipcc_2006_table_4_7_context.note: Research plots exceed the printed upper bound. Do not clamp to 1200.

sources.citation: Sillett et al. (2020). Forest Ecology and Management, article 117740.
Sillett et al. (2024). Forest Ecology and Management.

sites.name: Hubbard Brook Experimental Forest, New Hampshire, USA

map_anchor.coordinate_status: USDA Forest Service: 43°56' N, 71°45' W. Valley extent is 3138 ha; this is not one plot.

agb_mg_ha.definition_note: Van Doorn et al. 2011 call this live-tree biomass and total biomass. Treated here as aboveground live trees. Roots not confirmed from the abstract.

alternate_budget_fahey_2005_via_synthesi.source: Hubbard Brook synthesis Table 5.1, attributed to Fahey et al. 2005. Original 2005 article not re-read.

doi_10.1139/x06-261.nep_note: Paper states net ecosystem productivity was near zero. Do not put ANPP into the sequestration field.

stock_change.van_doorn_2011: No significant live-tree biomass change from 1995-96 to 2005-06.

sequestration_tier1_that_this_site_rejec.row: temperate continental forest > 20 years; Asia, Europe, and North America
sequestration_tier1_that_this_site_rejec.acceptable_only_if_labeled: IPCC default, not the Hubbard Brook remeasurement

sources.citation: van Doorn, N. S., Battles, J. J., Fahey, T. J., Siccama, T. G., and Schwarz, P. A. (2011).
Population and biomass dynamics of trees at Hubbard Brook (2007).

sites.name: Kruger National Park woody savanna, South Africa

map_anchor.suggested_landscape: Southern Kruger granite near Skukuza, upland, not the riparian corridor

orientation_pin.status: Approximate Skukuza area for map orientation only. Not a plot corner. Confirm on the basemap.

map_anchor.coordinate_status: park-wide statistic; a single polygon should not be scored against exactly 28.3

agb_mg_ha.excludes: Riparian woodlands, about 2-4% of park area
agb_mg_ha.unit_warning: The paper text says total woody AGB of 53.8 Gg. That unit disagrees with 28.3 Mg ha-1 times about 1.9 million ha (about 54 Tg). Use the density, not the Gg total.

derived_using_default_cf_on_park_mean.pool: woody aboveground only; grass is not included

sources.citation: Colgan, M. S., Asner, G. P., Levick, S. R., Martin, R. E., and Chadwick, O. A. (2012). Biogeosciences 9: 1809-1821.

sites.name: Saltbush pan-dune mosaic, Edwards Air Force Base, western Mojave Desert, California

map_anchor.coordinate_status: Printed in the paper as 34°50' N, 117°55' W. Vegetated dunes and flats, not the bare playa of Rogers Dry Lake.

agb_mg_ha.unit_in_paper: 503-1204 kg ha-1 aboveground shrub and bunchgrass biomass including dead material

derived_using_default_cf.cf_note: 0.47 is the forest default and the grassland herbaceous default. It is applied here only so the app's own formula can be checked. It is not a Mojave-specific assay.

screening.flux_fail_if: any IPCC forest Table 4.9 or 4.10 row is applied
screening.known_bad_model: Ilam Sentinel-2 equation AGB = -113.602 + 983.414*NDVI returns about 34 Mg ha-1 at NDVI 0.15, which fails this site.

sources.citation: Sharifi, R., Brostoff, W. N., and Rundel, P. W. (2017). Aliso 35(2).

order_check_note: Expected descending AGB for a correct system. Humboldt (GEDI landscape ~900, plots much higher) above Manaus (~300) above Hubbard Brook (~200-250) above Kruger (tens) above Mojave (~1).
